description: This Java source file defines the class 'KafkaPublishTarget' which implements the 'PublishTarget' interface. It represents a Kafka message destination including topic, key, and partition, and provides methods for parsing target addresses, validating components, and generating Kafka publish targets.

classes.name: KafkaPublishTarget
classes.description: An immutable class representing a Kafka publish target with methods for parsing addresses, validation, and comparison.

methods.name: fromTargetAddress
methods.description: Parses the target address string and returns a KafkaPublishTarget instance based on whether it contains a key or partition indicator, or just the topic.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks whether the provided target address contains a key segment.

methods.name: fromTargetAddressWithKey
methods.description: Creates a KafkaPublishTarget from an address string containing a key segment.

methods.name: validateKey
methods.description: Validates the key string; returns null if empty.

methods.name: containsPartition
methods.description: Checks whether the provided target address contains a partition segment.

methods.name: fromTargetAddressWithPartition
methods.description: Creates a KafkaPublishTarget from an address string containing a partition segment.

methods.name: validatePartition
methods.description: Validates and parses the partition string into an Integer.

methods.name: fromTargetAddressWithOnlyTopic
methods.description: Creates a KafkaPublishTarget with only a topic, without key or partition.

methods.name: validateTopic
methods.description: Validates the topic name using Kafka's Topic.validate method.

methods.name: parsePartitionOrThrow
methods.description: Parses the partition string into an Integer, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns the topic string of the KafkaPublishTarget.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the key if present.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the partition if present.
